title: Wardrobe colours
description: Colours an item can be tagged with. Items list colour ids, main colour first.

id.description: Stable id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Saved wardrobes refer to it, so it is never renamed or reused once shipped.

hex.description: Swatch colour shown in the app, as #rrggbb.

family.description: Colour family, so people can filter by "any red" as well as by exact colour.

aliases.description: Other names for this entry, so an imported item that uses one is filed under it. The entry’s own id also matches.
